RestoreWindow.description: Earliest and latest time an instance can be restored to.

EarliestTime.description: The earliest time you can restore an instance to.

LatestTime.description: The latest time you can restore an instance to.

Tag.description: Metadata assigned to an Amazon RDS resource consisting of a key-value pair.

Key.description: A key is the required name of the tag.

Value.description: A value is the optional value of the tag.

schema.description: Resource type definition for AWS::RDS::DBInstanceAutomatedBackup. An automated backup of a DB instance, consisting of system backups, transaction logs, and the DB instance properties that existed at the time the source instance was deleted.

AllocatedStorage.description: The allocated storage size for the automated backup in gibibytes (GiB).

AvailabilityZone.description: The Availability Zone that the automated backup was created in.

BackupRetentionPeriod.description: The retention period for the automated backups.

BackupTarget.description: The location where automated backups are stored: Dedicated Local Zones, AWS Outposts, or the AWS Region.

DBInstanceArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the source DB instance.

DBInstanceAutomatedBackupsArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the automated backup.

DBInstanceIdentifier.description: The identifier for the source DB instance, which can't be changed and which is unique to an AWS Region.

DbiResourceId.description: The resource ID for the source DB instance, which can't be changed and which is unique to an AWS Region.

Encrypted.description: Indicates whether the automated backup is encrypted.

Engine.description: The name of the database engine for this automated backup.

EngineVersion.description: The version of the database engine for the automated backup.

IAMDatabaseAuthenticationEnabled.description: Indicates whether mapping of AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) accounts to database accounts is enabled.

InstanceCreateTime.description: The date and time when the DB instance was created.

Iops.description: The IOPS (I/O operations per second) value for the automated backup.

KmsKeyId.description: The AWS KMS key ID for an automated backup.

LicenseModel.description: The license model information for the automated backup.

MasterUsername.description: The master user name of an automated backup.

OptionGroupName.description: The option group the automated backup is associated with.

Port.description: The port number that the automated backup used for connections.

Region.description: The AWS Region associated with the automated backup.

Status.description: The status of the automated backup: active for current instances, retained for deleted instances, or creating while waiting for the first automated snapshot to become available.

StorageThroughput.description: The storage throughput for the automated backup.

StorageType.description: The storage type associated with the automated backup.

Tags.description: A list of tags assigned to the automated backup.

VpcId.description: The VPC ID associated with the DB instance.
